title: Paine 1966: removing predators lowered diversity in the rocky intertidal
summary: Robert T. Paine's 1966 abstract says that where predators that prevent monopolies are missing or removed, rocky-intertidal systems become less diverse.
body: The abstract of Robert T. Paine's 1966 paper "Food Web Complexity and Species Diversity" says local animal species diversity is related to the number of predators and their efficiency at preventing a single species from monopolizing a limiting requirement. In the marine rocky intertidal, it says, that requirement usually is space. It says that where predators capable of preventing monopolies are missing, or are experimentally removed, the systems become less diverse. It also says that on a local scale no relationship between latitude, from 10 degrees to 49 degrees north, and diversity was found. The general rule is stated as a suggestion. The removal result is what the abstract reports for those shores. One paper's abstract does not settle every food web.
